items.description: Local Weather is a web application that automatically show users their local weather forecast. This application uses ipinfo.io API and OpenWeatherMap API.

Visual Traceroute is a web application that enables users to trace the path packets take through the Internet, by entering the URL. This application uses ipinfo.io API for geolocation and ISP details.
Map based data visualization tool driven by Pentaho open source business intelligence tools and Google Maps.
Automate downloads of your website traffic data from your Google Analytics account directly into Excel.
Create you own winery tour! Mashup of U.S. wineries, winery events, wine festivals, and wine trails. Over 3,200 entries. Includes printable Google directions with full winery contact information.
Enables Twitter users to call each other for free, without revealing their phone numbers to one another.
Useful mashup that lets you see who has been donating money to which political party by zip code. Good combination of raw data, charts and maps. Data source is The Fundrace Project.
Painless sharing of your Flickr images by tag or set across Facebook & Twitter. Group sharing supported and multiple accounts supported.
The CNN iReports Map, set on the Barack Obama inauguration parade route, allows readers to submit their own stories and reports from the event.

Vertical search for US Colleges and Universities. The site includes in-depth information such as tuition cost and retention information on over seven-thousand schools. Check out a birds-eye view of the colleges.
Open-FTP is a bouncer for your downloadable files. Open-FTP controls access to your shared files and will even text you if someone downloads one.

Find Me Similar is a web application that let users find recommendations for their games and movies. The recommendations are generated based on multiple factors such as genres, plots, actors, game type, and more.
